text: It was a well-lit place, but not a big.
The friend of the station where the
pumps had been placed and was covered
with a metallic roof supported by a long
steel structure. He stopped his red 1993
BMW at one of the pumps and filled up
tank. Another car was parked at the
pump. There were only four of them. Jake
looked inside and saw a woman and a
little guy through the window. They were
looking as if they didn't know what to
buy. He looked around again and couldn't
see anything. The lights were bright all
around the place, so he wasn't able to
discern anything much farther away in
the dark. What he had seen
earlier left an uneasy feeling inside
